title: Path vacancy_id is never bound to the path application_id: a same-owner vacancy mismatch passes the ownership prechecks, the application-trio UPDATE then silently 0-rows, and correct/substitute still return 200 + audit with the app trio stale (also bypasses the archived-vacancy 422 guard)
evidence: run_action_with_prechecks (actions_handler.gleam:544-554) runs ai_sql.verify_application_ownership(db, app_uuid, landlord_uuid) then app_sql.verify_vacancy_active(db, vacancy_uuid, landlord_uuid) and dispatches the action when both pass. verify_application_ownership.sql is `SELECT count(*)::int AS match_count FROM application a JOIN vacancy v ON v.id = a.vacancy_id WHERE a.id = $1 AND v.user_id = $2` — it binds the application to its OWN vacancy via the join but never compares the PATH vacancy_id to a.vacancy_id. verify_vacancy_active.sql is `SELECT (archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_archived FROM vacancy WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2` — it only proves the landlord owns the PATH vacancy and reads its archive flag. Neither check requires path vacancy == the application's vacancy, so a request like POST /api/v1/vacancies/<vacancy-B>/applications/<app-on-A>/reference-checks/<call>/correct (landlord owns both A and B) passes every precheck. The trio UPDATE then runs `UPDATE application SET landlord_ref_* = ... WHERE id = $1 AND vacancy_id = $2` (update_application_referee_trio_landlord.sql) — 0 rows on the mismatch — and do_correct's arm `case update_trio(tx, app_uuid, vacancy_uuid, row.ref_slot, trio) { Error(err) -> Error(DbFailure(err)); Ok(_) -> ... audit_log.create ... Ok(True) }` (actions_handler.gleam:211-232) treats ANY row count including 0 as success: the row still transitions (correct_reference_call already committed the status/corrected_*/correction_cycles change), the ReferenceCallCorrected audit is written, and the handler returns 200 {"corrected":true} while the application trio was never updated. do_substitute has the identical arm (actions_handler.gleam:369-380) — the substitute row is inserted with the new trio but the application trio silently stays stale. The same precheck gap lets a landlord bypass the archived-vacancy 422 guard (actions_handler.gleam:546-552) by naming an unarchived owned vacancy in the path while the application's real vacancy is archived. The c2 cross-application test (correct_validation_and_cross_application_guards_test) does not cover this shape: it uses a second seeded LANDLORD, so its 404 comes from verify_application_ownership, not from any vacancy↔application binding.
analysis: This is not a cross-tenant authorization hole — the row-level guarded UPDATEs still scope application_id to the path app, verify_application_ownership still requires the app to belong to the authenticated landlord, and the row read 404s on any application mismatch. The defect is integrity/consistency within the landlord's own tenant: the endpoint reports success (200, audit row, and for correct also a real row-state transition) while the A1 'application trio updated inline' guarantee silently does not happen, leaving the panel chips and future trigger slot-selection reading a stale referee. It also neutralizes the archived-vacancy business guard for these three endpoints whenever the landlord holds a second unarchived vacancy. Reachable only by a crafted request from the owning landlord (the SPA always sends the vacancy the app belongs to), so severity is warning, not blocker. The fix is cheap: bind the path vacancy to the application in the prechecks (e.g. extend verify_application_ownership's WHERE with a.vacancy_id = $3), or treat a 0-row update_trio result as an error and roll back (mirroring the correct_reference_call 0-row -> NotAwaitingCorrection handling), and pin it with a same-landlord, different-vacancy integration test.
recommendation: Make verify_application_ownership (or a new precheck) require a.vacancy_id = <path vacancy id>, and/or have do_correct/do_substitute treat a 0-row update_trio result as a rollback error (the same way the 0-row correct_reference_call result already maps to NotAwaitingCorrection). Add an integration test: same landlord, two vacancies, correct/substitute with the wrong vacancy in the path — assert 4xx and no state change (no audit, no transition).
